why: mobile_scanner 5.2.3 (lib/src/web/zxing/zxing_barcode_reader.dart, scriptUrl) injects that unpkg URL into document.head at the first scan: no integrity, no pin, dead offline or behind a merchant firewall, and incompatible with script-src 'self'. Vendoring the identical artifact removes the runtime supply-chain dependency without changing what the plugin was tested against.
how_it_is_used: web/index.html pre-loads this file under the id mobile-scanner-barcode-reader, which is the id barcode_reader.dart checks for before injecting its own script tag.
